rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AI Infrastructure Agent by VersusControl that provides autonomous AWS infrastructure management through natural language processing and state-aware decision making. Built with Go using the AWS SDK v2, langchaingo for multi-LLM support (OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic), and mark3labs/mcp-go for Model Context Protocol integration, the implementation combines AI-driven infrastructure planning with real-time AWS resource discovery, conflict detection, and dependency graph analysis. The agent maintains persistent infrastructure state, correlates managed resources with discovered AWS resources, and executes step-by-step deployment plans through granular MCP tools covering EC2, VPC, Auto Scaling, Load Balancers, RDS, and security groups. Designed for DevOps teams and infrastructure engineers who need conversational infrastructure management with built-in safety through dry-run modes, conflict resolution, and comprehensive state tracking across complex AWS environments.
